notes: Calls through values whose type the adapter cannot tell do not appear, unless one method of the project alone carries the name; such calls count as heuristic.
A call through a base class or a protocol points at that class's method.
Monkey-patching, setattr, getattr with a computed name and __getattr__ hide what code runs; the map shows only names written in the code.
A decorator that changes a signature leaves the signature as the def writes it; metaclasses and class decorators add no members.
Code at module level, outside functions, makes no calls on the map, except inside a main guard.
Type stubs (.pyi) do not appear; the adapter reads one distribution per root.
A write to an attribute through another reference, or through setattr, stays unseen, so the attribute may keep a type that such a write breaks.
The resolver ignores the order of statements: a name that del removes counts as unknown everywhere.
Of 91 call sites, 40 resolved to code on the map, 28 to outside code or built-ins, 1 by a unique method name (heuristic), and 22 to nothing.
Units import 6 outside packages; the adapter installs nothing, so their types count as unknown.

doc.raw:
The lending rules.

A :class:`Library` applies the rules to a :class:`~lending.store.base.Store`.
The rules:

- a member holds at most :data:`~lending.domain.MAX_LOANS` books;
- a book on loan cannot go out again.

Use it like this::

    lib = Library(MemoryStore())
    lib.borrow("b1", "ann")

.. versionadded:: 0.1
